'''Nor'dro the Fearless''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived at some point before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bowdaar]], before being purchased by [[Drooga]] the Hutt for his entertainment.
